title: block 拖消 project V2
$comment: Generated by npm run schemas:generate from persisted TS types and live game contracts. Do not edit this file directly.
description: Structural validation only. Run the owning game validation, replay and asset resolver for cross-field identity, geometry, hashes, resource budgets and rendering readiness.

AgentAssetRefEntry.description:
An asset whose bytes are held outside the project JSON. `data` is deliberately
absent rather than optional: that makes every existing `.data` reader a compile
error, instead of a value that type-checks and fails at render time.

playback.description: Present only for sequence slots; image slots reject it.

AgentSequenceAsset.description: Ordered transparent PNG frames stored as one asset, hashed frame by frame.

AgentSequencePlayback.description:
Deterministic sequence playback. Elapsed frames come from the bound event's own
presentation window, so a seek renders the same sprite frame as sequential playback.

BBReference_ReferenceAppearance.description: Measured reusable faces, never a sequence of gameplay images.

boardCelebrations.description: Explicit noninteractive celebration; visual tiles never enter gameplay state.

backdropTimeline.description: Empty decorative scene plates only; gameplay tiles remain native.

decorations.description: Timed native UI ornaments measured independently of gameplay changes.

landingPreview.description: Lifted projection of the moving piece, not its eventual recorded target.

shakeBackground.description: Include the authored scene plate in the camera transform, rather than only live tiles.

BBReference_ReferencePreviewDrag.description: A lifted real rack piece that is never committed as a rule action.

returnToRack.description: Defaults to returning to the rack. False is only valid at the end of the scene.

BBReference_ReferenceProgressHud.description: Measured UI-only meter. Values do not affect the game's score or rules.

clearAxes.description: Explicit authored line rule; omitted preserves historical row-and-column clears.

supplyExhausted.description: True only when the final authored round was consumed.

BlockPlacementStyle.description: Known native visual fields; renderer/effect extensions may add fields and validate them in their own package.

MediaRef.description: Project-relative attachment, CAS or hash-pinned library reference. Bytes and hashes are checked by the resolver.

PointerSample.description: Viewport-normalized pointer coordinates plus a frame offset from drag start.

mastering.description: Opt-in reference audio path; the default soft limiter remains unchanged.

screenFx.description: 全屏光效(可选, 默认 none): clear-bloom = 消除时全屏径向光爆+光束。

praiseWords.description: Optional vocabulary shared by rendered praise and voice events; legacy words remain the default.

materialTheme.description: Optional coordinated material-study theme. Legacy projects retain their palette.

cellGapPx.description: Visual seam in reference design pixels; grid centers and game geometry do not change.

appearance.description: Measured reusable faces, never a sequence of gameplay images.

backdrop.description: Optional themed static backdrop and coordinated board surface colors.

ReferenceCalibration.description: BB reference calibration V1. Coordinates use the 1080x1920 design space; times are output seconds. Absence preserves the existing renderer. Replay identity, ordered/relative times, atlas bounds and asset bytes require parseReferenceCalibration.

exposure.description: Multiplier over the lighting preset exposure.

environmentIntensity.description: Multiplier applied to material environment reflections.

bloomStrength.description: Baseline bloom contribution outside clear events.

clearBloomBoost.description: Additional bloom added only during a clear event.
